# Build & Assembly

There are two build paths depending on how many modules you want to run.

<div class="grid cards" markdown>

- :material-numeric-8-box: **Original display — up to 8 modules**

    ---

    Single I²C bus, up to 8 modules. The original design by Morgan Manly, with a hand-wired or DIY PCB approach.

    [:octicons-arrow-right-24: Original build guide](original/index.md)

- :material-numeric-16-box: **Dual display — up to 16 modules**

    ---

    Dual I²C bus configuration using the custom v5.1 PCB. Fully assembled boards from JLCPCB.

    [:octicons-arrow-right-24: Dual display guide](dual-display/index.md)

</div>

## Which path is right for you?

| | Original (≤8 modules) | Dual display (≤16 modules) |
|---|---|---|
| Max modules | 8 | 16 |
| PCB | DIY / hand-wired | Custom v5.1 (JLCPCB assembled) |
| I²C buses | 1 | 2 |
| Difficulty | Moderate | Easier (SMT assembled) |
| Cost | Lower upfront | ~$90 for 10 PCBs assembled |
